---
title: "Project A dashboard"
format: dashboard
---

```{python}
#| include: false
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px

tables = Path("..") / "projects" / "a_who_pays" / "outputs" / "tables"
grid = pd.read_csv(tables / "threshold_grid.csv")
coverage = pd.read_csv(tables / "indigent_coverage.csv")
split = pd.read_csv(tables / "split_summary.csv")
cf = pd.read_csv(tables / "counterfactual_grid.csv")
headline = grid.loc[(grid["threshold"] - 0.10).abs().idxmin()]
```

## Row {height=25%}

```{python}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Households above a 10% bill-to-income threshold"
dict(icon="house", color="primary", value=f"{headline['share_above'] * 100:.1f}%")
```

```{python}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Non-paying households able to pay (mid case, 10% threshold)"
row = split.loc[(split["threshold"] - 0.10).abs().idxmin()]
dict(icon="people", color="info", value=f"{row['able_to_pay_mid'] / 1e6:.1f} million")
```

## Row {height=75%}

```{python}
#| title: "Affordability threshold curve"
fig = px.line(grid, x=grid["threshold"] * 100, y=grid["share_above"] * 100,
              labels={"x": "Threshold (% of income)", "y": "Households above (%)"})
fig
```

```{python}
#| title: "Indigent registration coverage by province"
data = coverage[coverage["cutoff_rand"] == 4500].sort_values("coverage")
px.bar(data, x=data["coverage"] * 100, y="province", orientation="h",
       labels={"x": "Registered as % of qualifying households"})
```

```{python}
#| title: "Counterfactual price change"
px.line(cf, x=cf["able_share"] * 100, y="change_vs_payers_only_pct",
        color=cf["unpaid_share"].astype(str),
        labels={"x": "Share of non-payers able to pay (%)",
                "y": "Change in price (%)", "color": "Unpaid share"})
```
